ops.new_text:
\begin{abstract}
\rev{How electrocardiogram (ECG) representations compare for label-free clustering under
chance-corrected metrics has not been measured. We benchmark four representation families for
separating sinus rhythm (SR) from atrial fibrillation (AF) in 2\,542 PTB-XL records. They are
raw flattening, a convolutional autoencoder, 16 hand-crafted features and two frozen foundation
models, HuBERT-ECG and ECGFounder. Five clusterers are scored by the chance-corrected adjusted
Rand index (ARI). Evaluation is patient-grouped and repeated over ten seeds for the clusterers
that depend on one. Bracketed values are 95\% bootstrap intervals. ECGFounder clusters best (ARI
0.885 [0.860, 0.909]) and the hand-crafted features are competitive (0.711 [0.677, 0.746]). Raw
flattening and the autoencoder match a majority-class assignment (ARI at most 0.013). HuBERT-ECG
carries the label (supervised linear-probe ceiling 0.899) yet clusters weakly (ARI 0.195). A
discriminant fitted on other patients raises its held-out ARI from 0.160 to 0.549. The ranking is
largely expected, since SR and AF differ by definition in rhythm regularity.} The silhouette
score rewards the degenerate one-cluster solution (silhouette 0.81 at ARI \rev{0.000}) and cannot
validate ECG clustering alone. \rev{The ordering replicates on MIT-BIH beat morphology, where 21
hand-crafted features reach ARI 0.783. Under a 9:1 SR:AF imbalance the hand-crafted features
overtake ECGFounder (ARI 0.265 against 0.063). Under simulated federation across ten
heterogeneous sites, the two mean ARIs are close (0.591 against 0.612). The hand-crafted features
retain 0.92 of their centralized ARI against 0.69 for ECGFounder and never fall below 0.455.
Their extraction is also fifteen times cheaper per record than ECGFounder's. Beyond the closest
foundation-model benchmark, we add a hand-crafted baseline, supervised ceilings with an
out-of-fold test, a second dataset and deployment stressors. On these two binary tasks and two
foundation models, the representation mattered more than the clusterer for recovering the
classes.}
\end{abstract}

ops.rationale: Replaces the two keywords that repeat the title (unsupervised clustering, representation learning) with atrial fibrillation, hand-crafted features and MIT-BIH, so the seven terms complement the title and name the class, the competing representation and the second dataset.
